BOOK ONE · LESSON 101

A card from Jimmy

吉米的明信片

A dialogue lesson on reported speech. Grandmother asks Penny to read Jimmy's card to her. Penny reads the card (direct speech) and then reports it in indirect speech ('He says he's just arrived in Scotland. He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.'). Grandmother asks what else Jimmy says, and Penny reports that he'll write a letter soon and hopes they are all well. Grandmother, who can't hear very well, asks Penny to speak up. New vocabulary includes Scotland, card, youth, hostel, association, soon, and write. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and choosing the best word to fill in the blanks. Grammar exercises practise making sentences according to the example (reported speech with 'that') and rewriting sentences using a noun clause according to the example.

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
听录音，然后回答问题。收到吉米寄来的一张明信片，祖母是否显得高兴？为什么？

Listen to the recording and answer: Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?

  1. 1

    GRANDMOTHER

    Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.

    祖母：请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，彭妮。

  2. 2

    PENNY

    'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'

    彭妮："我刚到苏格兰，我现在住在一所青年招待所。"

  3. 3

    GRANDMOTHER

    Eh?

    祖母：什么？

  4. 4

    PENNY

    He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
    He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
    You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.

    彭妮：他说他刚到苏格兰。他说他现住在一所青年招待所。您知道，他是 Y.H.A. 的一个会员。

  5. 5

    GRANDMOTHER

    The what?

    祖母：什么？

  6. 6

    PENNY

    The Y.H.A., Mum.
    The Youth Hostels Association.

    彭妮：Y.H.A.，妈妈。青年招待所协会。

  7. 7

    GRANDMOTHER

    What else does he say?

    祖母：他还说了些什么？

  8. 8

    PENNY

    'I'll write a letter soon.
    I hope you are all well.'

    彭妮："我很快会写信的。祝你们大家身体都好。"

  9. 9

    GRANDMOTHER

    What?
    Speak up, Penny.
    I'm afraid I can't hear you.

    祖母：什么？彭妮，大声一点。我可听不见你念的。

  10. 10

    PENNY

    He says he'll write a letter soon.
    He hopes we are all well.
    'Love, Jimmy.'

    彭妮：他说他很快会写信的。他祝我们大家身体好。"爱你们的吉米。"

  11. 11

    GRANDMOTHER

    Is that all?
    He doesn't say very much, does he?

    祖母：就这些吗？他没写多少，是吗？

  12. 12

    PENNY

    He can't write very much
    on a card, Mum.

    彭妮：在明信片上他写不了很多，妈妈。

Notes on the text 课文注释

'I have just arrived in Scotland ... a Youth Hostel.'

这是一个直接引语的例子。直接引语是英文中用书面语的形式来表示口语的方式，实际讲的话要放在引号之间，句尾的标点符号也要放在引号之内。

the Y.H.A. = the Youth Hostels Association

青年招待所协会，简称 Y.H.A.。Youth Hostel 是一种为参加野外探险度假活动的青年人提供廉价住宿的招待所。这种青年招待所实行会员制，首先要加入 Y.H.A. 才有资格享受这种待遇。

speak up

speak up, 大声地说。

Love, Jimmy.

Love, Jimmy. 爱你们的吉米。Yours, Jimmy（你的，吉米）。这是亲人朋友间通信时常用的结束语。

He doesn't say very much, does he?

这是英文中的反意疑问句，它是由两部分组成的，前面是一个陈述句，逗号之后是一个简略问句。反意疑问句可以用来确认自己的判断，获取真实的信息，还可以用来表示惊讶、愤怒等感情。如果前一部分陈述句是肯定形式，简略问句就要用否定形式；如果前一部分是否定形式，后一部分则用肯定形式。
